title: The Primer of Seeming
summary: A plain primer that teaches a new illusionist to cast a thin false sight and to tell a true shape from a false one.

title: A Beginner's Book of Glamour
summary: A book for beginners on laying a glamour over the face and the hands so that a foe misjudges what he sees.

title: The Mirage Handbook
summary: A handbook of small mirages cast at arm's length that bend distance and hide where the true body stands.

title: Simple Lessons in Afterimage
summary: Short lessons on leaving a faint copy of the body behind each step so that a foe strikes the empty place.

title: The Illusionist's First Course
summary: The full first course of the illusion discipline that covers sight and guard and movement and the senses in turn.

title: Primer of the Veiled Hand
summary: A primer on hiding the motion of the hand and the arm so that the true strike is never read in time.

title: The Shimmer Reader
summary: A reader of exercises in bending light and sound a little off true until a foe doubts his own senses.

title: Notes on the Mind's Eye Trick
summary: Plain notes on planting a picture in the mind of a watcher and on keeping one's own mind clear of such pictures.
